weaknesses.title: Empty WHERE and true-zero both yield LAST_N=0
weaknesses.detail: SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX on no match return 0. Agents cannot tell missing zone from all-zero loads without also checking SUMWHERE_N / MINWHERE_N.
weaknesses.repro: sum nozone → 0 N=0; sum us-east with loads 0 → 0 N=2

weaknesses.title: Budget admit on empty zone always succeeds for BUDGET≥0
weaknesses.detail: sum=0 ≤ budget admits ghost zones; no built-in require N>0. Must gate SUMWHERE_N separately.

weaknesses.title: MINWHERE/MAXWHERE return value only — no argmin object id
weaknesses.detail: Cannot pick least-loaded shard in zone without GETFWHERE+scan or MAXOBJ-style sibling. Value alone is not actionable for schedule-to.
weaknesses.repro: MINWHERE load zone us-east → 20 not h1

weaknesses.title: Zone match equality only — no prefix/glob
weaknesses.detail: us vs us-east is exact false friend (good for safety) but multi-zone rollups need repeated SUMWHERE or FREQF-style groupby (missing).

weaknesses.title: AVGWHERE integer mean — truncates
weaknesses.detail: Proof uses even sums; fractional means floor. Capacity ratios may under-read without float path.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE/BUDGET softens
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_FS_REQUIRE=abc → soft; BUDGET garbage keeps default.
